title: Emitting Events: Child to Parent Communication
description: Let child components talk back to parents using custom events and $emit.

slides.title: From Child to Parent with $emit
slides.content:
# Custom Events

Props handle parent → child. For child → parent communication, the child **emits an event** that the parent listens to.

```javascript
// Child component
this.$emit('event-name', payload);
```

```html
<!-- Parent template -->
<child-component @event-name="parentMethod" />
```

The payload (optional) is passed to the parent's method.
